eval.title: Google Stock Update - Key Risk is HuuuuAIuuuge!

call.headline_quote: for now for Value investors watch it as I say always watch it before it becomes too late

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: they are now at a p ratio of 20 so that's 5% plus some growth and maybe even less growth

what_is_priced_in.quote: they are now at a p ratio of 20 so that's 5% plus some growth and maybe even less growth

reasons.claim: The AI search race is still open and it is unclear whether Google can keep up, which raises uncertainty about its future cash flows.
reasons.quote: who will win the AI search is still an open race I believe

reasons.claim: Google cannot roll out AI search fast because it would cannibalize the ad revenue generated by traditional search, leaving an opening for competitors.
reasons.quote: if they would develop an AI solution now fast then they would cannibalize their own search income and that's the key for Google so they cannot put in Ai

reasons.claim: More and more people, including older users, are switching from Google search to AI tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity, a warning sign of disruption.
reasons.quote: how many people here are already using chat GPT or complexity instead of Google for things they used Google for just two years ago

reasons.claim: A large share of the buybacks is offset by heavy stock-based compensation, reducing their real benefit to shareholders.
reasons.quote: 60 billion in BuyBacks and then someone said here that 20 billion is for stock compensation so 60 it is $40 billion so that's already two3 of the BuyBacks

data_check.gap_note: he says 6e+10, as-of -6.1504e+10 (FY2023); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Google's low P/E relative to the market and its Magnificent 7 peers reflects the AI risk being priced in, which is why he still finds it cheap.
reasons.quote: this explains why Google is cheap the cheaper of The Magnificent 7

external_facts_used: AI analysis of 149 YouTube comments (40% positive, 30% undecided, 30% negative)
Gary Vaynerchuk's public comments about Google search being disrupted by AI
$50 billion Google AI investment / $40 billion capex figure mentioned
Google's stock-based compensation and buyback figures from viewer comments

critic.notes: He raises Google's risk and lowers cash flows on his quadrant, ~5% plus uncertain growth, tells value investors only to watch it 'before it becomes too late' — reads as avoid/too risky for the return, not a hold.
